abstract: OBJECTIVES: Incidence rates for testicular cancer have risen over the last few decades. Findings of an association between the risk of testicular cancer and social factors are controversial. The association of testicular cancer and different indicators of social factors were examined in this study. DESIGN: Case-control study. SETTING: Population-based multicentre study in four German regions (city states Bremen and Hamburg, the Saarland region and the city of Essen). PARTICIPANTS: The study included 797 control participants and 266 participants newly diagnosed with testicular cancer of which 167 cases were classified as seminoma and 99 as non-seminoma. The age of study participants ranged from 15 to 69 years. METHODS: Social position was classified by educational attainment level, posteducational training, occupational sectors according to Erikson-Goldthorpe-Portocarrero (EGP) and the socioeconomic status (SES) on the basis of the International SocioEconomic Index of occupational status (ISEI). ORs and corresponding 95% CIs (95% CIs) were calculated for the whole study sample and for seminoma and non-seminoma separately. RESULTS: Testicular cancer risk was modestly increased among participants with an apprenticeship (OR=1.7 (95% CI 1.0 to 2.8)) or a university degree (OR=1.6 (95% CI 0.9 to 2.8)) relative to those whose education was limited to school. Analysis of occupational sectors revealed an excess risk for farmers and farm-related occupations. No clear trend was observed for the analyses according to the ISEI-scale. CONCLUSIONS: Social factors based on occupational measures were not a risk factor for testicular cancer in this study. The elevated risk in farmers and farm-related occupations warrants further research including analysis of occupational exposures.
abstract_ja:
目的：精巣がんの発生率は過去数十年にわたって上昇している。社会的要因と精巣がんリスクとの関連については議論がある。本研究では、精巣がんと社会的要因の各指標との関連を検討した。
デザイン：症例対照研究。
設定：ドイツ4地域(ブレーメン州およびハンブルク州、ザールラント州、エッセン市)で行われた住民ベースの多施設共同研究。
対象者：対照797名、新たに精巣がんと診断された266名(セミノーマ167例、非セミノーマ99例)。年齢は15〜69歳。
方法：社会的地位を、教育水準、教育後の訓練、Erikson-Goldthorpe-Portocarrero(EGP)職業区分、および国際職業社会経済指数(ISEI)に基づく社会経済的地位(SES)で分類した。オッズ比(OR)と95%信頼区間(95%CI)を、全対象およびセミノーマと非セミノーマのそれぞれについて算出した。
結果：徒弟修業を経た者(OR=1.7(95%CI 1.0〜2.8))や大学学位を持つ者(OR=1.6(95%CI 0.9〜2.8))では、学校教育のみの者に比べ精巣がんリスクがわずかに上昇した。職業区分では農業従事者および農業関連職種で過剰リスクがみられた。ISEI尺度では明確な傾向は認められなかった。
結論：職業に基づく社会的要因は、本研究では精巣がんの危険因子ではなかった。農業従事者における高リスクについては、職業曝露を含むさらなる研究が必要である。
